checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja recovers one function 0x004C6240-0x004C666C (1069 bytes, 25 blocks, 36 edges); radare2 recovers the same 25/36 graph; angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate entry is igi::retail::terrain::Terrain_Load at 0x0045f3f0 (383 bytes, 12 blocks, 16 edges) in igi1.exe 35d92a3a, delegating to TerrainLevelData::Terrain_LoadLevel.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail is x86 cdecl with context at [esp+4] and the path pointer at [esp+8]; the candidate takes void* context and const char* base_path in the same order. Retail appends .bit/.hmp/.cmd/.ctr to the supplied string; the host bridge treats base_path as the terrain directory and reads fixed TERRAIN.* names. Documented adaptation, not a byte-identical path contract.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail uses suffixes .bit/.hmp/.cmd/.ctr, a 0xC00-byte .bit header, 0x1000-byte resource grids and context offsets +0xDCC (bit records), +0xDD0 (heightmap) and +0xDC8. The host bridge reads the same files through TerrainLevelData with typed vectors; no literal constant equivalence is claimed beyond the recovered file layout.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail writes byte-addressed context offsets; the host bridge stores typed containers in TerrainLevelData. There is no byte-identical memory layout to compare, so the memory check does not apply to this adapted implementation.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail calls Render_ComputeNormals, Resource_Load/Resource_FileExists, Game_DefineOptions, the QVM task loader/executor/cleanup, Mem_AllocFn and DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11. The host bridge calls Terrain_LoadLevel with apply_tasks=false and does not run the retail resource or script-VM chain, so call and side-effect equivalence is out of scope.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail has a single ret at 0x004C666C; its only tail call is DynObj_UpdateDynTree_11(context) at 0x004C665A, whose EAX is arg1, so EAX equals the context argument (live level-1 capture 0x038910B4). The candidate returns context and adds a host-only null guard that returns nullptr; that guard has no retail counterpart and is declared as a deviation.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Neither the retail body nor the candidate performs floating-point arithmetic.
